parameters.content:
## PETER PAN — PETER Flow (Stage A, mock-first)

Source of truth: docs/peter-pan-n8n-flow.mmd + docs/BUILD_PLAN.md.
Contracts: docs/contracts (TriageReport schema frozen — changes need an ADR).

**Env vars (n8n instance settings):** PETER_GUARDRAILS_URL, PETER_PREDICTOR_URL, PETER_RAG_URL, PETER_LANGGRAPH_URL, PETER_TOOLS_URL, PETER_REVIEW_QUEUE_URL, PETER_DB_TEAM_WEBHOOK, PETER_INFRA_TEAM_WEBHOOK, PETER_APP_TEAM_WEBHOOK, PETER_TRIAGE_TEAM_WEBHOOK, PETER_SLACK_STUB_URL, PETER_GITHUB_API, PETER_GITHUB_REPO.

**Credentials (fill in n8n, never inline):** "PETER Services Bearer" = shared-secret for the EC2 services; "PETER Mock LLM (OpenAI-compatible)" = base URL of the Stage A FixtureLLM service. Stage C swaps this credential to real per-task providers (Gemini 2.5 Flash extract, Bedrock Claude Sonnet agent/synthesis — ADR 0002) — nodes stay unchanged.

## Context enrichment (Stage A)
Maintenance window = static stub (Stage C: calendar). Deploys = real GitHub API against a fake repo. Complaints = fixture stub (Stage C: Slack reader). Merged output validates as IncidentContext. Known-noise rule is deterministic code, not LLM.

attributes.name: service
attributes.description: Name of the affected service or component. Extract only if explicitly named.

attributes.name: environment
attributes.description: Deployment environment: production or staging. Null if not stated.

attributes.name: started_at
attributes.description: When the issue began, as stated in the text, ISO 8601 if possible. Null if not mentioned.

attributes.name: symptom
attributes.description: One-sentence observable symptom, quoting the text. Null if none.

attributes.name: affected_metric
attributes.description: The primary metric in trouble. Null if none named.

attributes.name: error_signature
attributes.description: Exception class, HTTP status code, or error string mentioned. Null if absent.

attributes.name: customer_impact
attributes.description: Stated user-facing impact. Null if not mentioned.

attributes.name: mentioned_deploys
attributes.description: Any deploy, release, or change reference mentioned. Empty if none.

options.systemMessage: You are a senior incident commander for a production SRE team. Always call Predictor Tool first. For a normal single-domain incident, then call RAG Query Tool and Service Context Tool; do not call LangGraph. For a complex cross-domain incident, call LangGraph Agent Tool after Predictor and do not call RAG directly because LangGraph owns retrieval. Return one JSON object containing the exact tool results under predictor, rag, service_context, or langgraph. Never invent severity, category, owners, escalation paths, citations, runbook IDs, or root causes.

parameters.toolDescription: Classifies the incident into an objective CATEGORY and SEVERITY score with confidence, from the metric window. Do NOT guess severity yourself — always call this first.
Retrieves similar PAST INCIDENTS and matching RUNBOOK sections with citations (source_id, source_type, quote). Input: a short natural-language description of the current incident.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { query: $fromAI("query", "short incident description to search runbooks and incident history", "string"), limit: 3 } }}

parameters.toolDescription: Runs deep multi-step Planner-Specialists-Synthesiser reasoning across infra, database and application specialists. Call ONLY for complex cross-domain incidents. Returns findings, owner_team and escalation_path grounded in the Tools API.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { incident: $('Assemble Incident').item.json, question: $fromAI('question', 'what to analyse for this incident', 'string') } }}

parameters.toolDescription: Returns the deterministic owner_team and escalation_path for the incident service. Call for normal single-domain incidents after Predictor and RAG.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { service: $('Assemble Incident').item.json.service, environment: $('Assemble Incident').item.json.environment, severity: $fromAI('severity', 'P-level from Predictor Tool, such as P1 or P3', 'string') } }}

messageValues.message: You are the incident report writer. Synthesise the incident, the predictor severity/category, and the RAG runbook context into one TriageReport matching the schema exactly. Deterministic floors: category must be one of infra, database, application. owner_team and escalation_path may ONLY be copied from tool results in the findings — if absent use "unknown" and []. Map predictor severity to p_level: 5 to P1, 4 to P2, 3 to P3, 1-2 to P4; the predictor proposal wins over your own judgement. Every citations[] entry must copy a real source_id, source_type and quote from tool output — never invent citations; if you cannot cite, say "insufficient data" in probable_cause and lower confidence. recommended_steps must be read-only or safe diagnostic actions, never destructive commands.

parameters.inputSchema: {"$defs":{"Citation":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"source_id":{"title":"Source Id","type":"string"},"source_type":{"enum":["runbook","incident_history","service_doc","tool_result"],"title":"Source Type","type":"string"},"quote":{"maxLength":500,"title":"Quote","type":"string"}},"required":["source_id","source_type","quote"],"title":"Citation","type":"object"}},"additionalProperties":false,"description":"The one artifact PETER PAN produces. Output-guardrail-checked before routing.","properties":{"incident_id":{"title":"Incident Id","type":"string"},"category":{"enum":["infra","database","application"],"title":"Category","type":"string"},"p_level":{"enum":["P1","P2","P3","P4"],"title":"P Level","type":"string"},"summary":{"maxLength":1200,"minLength":1,"title":"Summary","type":"string"},"probable_cause":{"maxLength":1200,"title":"Probable Cause","type":"string"},"citations":{"items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/Citation"},"minItems":1,"title":"Citations","type":"array"},"owner_team":{"title":"Owner Team","type":"string"},"escalation_path":{"items":{"type":"string"},"title":"Escalation Path","type":"array"},"recommended_steps":{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":8,"title":"Recommended Steps","type":"array"},"confidence":{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"title":"Confidence","type":"number"},"guardrail_flags":{"items":{"type":"string"},"title":"Guardrail Flags","type":"array"},"generated_at":{"format":"date-time","title":"Generated At","type":"string"},"model_meta":{"additionalProperties":{"type":"string"},"title":"Model Meta","type":"object"}},"required":["incident_id","category","p_level","summary","probable_cause","citations","owner_team","confidence","generated_at"],"title":"TriageReport","type":"object"}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { report: $json, service: $('Assemble Incident').item.json.service, environment: $('Assemble Incident').item.json.environment, require_tool_evidence: true } }}
